# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden trial records report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records in the supplied invented-index fixture (input.json / fixture-001.json) describing learning-garden or related guided-session trials.
- Any year; English.

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not present in the supplied fixture.
- Records without a retrievable source passage.

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 - invented-index: supplied fixture `fixture-001.json` (no live backend searched; entirely invented records) -> 2 hits

## Notes
- Evaluation capture mode: claim/source pairs and synthesis wording preserved verbatim from the fixture. Validation, repair, and delivery are left to the evaluation harness.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (La Cruz, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (de la Cruz, 2025).
